title: The Roald Amundsen Diaries
author: Roald Amundsen; Geir O. Kløver (editor)

pages.evidence: First Time Published Amundsen, Roald. The Roald Amundsen Diaries: The South Pole Expedition 1910-1912. Oslo: The Fram Museum, #9788282350105, 2010, 1st edition. (Softcover) 411pp.

limitations: No explicit page ranges for bibliographical references were found. The book review mentions that the Fram Museum edition includes an appendix on modifications made to Fram for its Antarctic voyage (reprinted from The South Pole), and a register of the contents of each crate carried on the southern journey. However, these are not explicitly stated as bibliographical references and their page ranges are not provided. The review also notes that there is no index.
